translations.translatedText: # Sunday 17.4.2022 (radio)
The situation in Ukraine. Riots in Sweden. Popularity of electric cars. Easter. The Pope appealed for peace. Weather forecast.
## Mariupol
![Map showing the location of Mariupol.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-942943625b0014c0612/1650131228)
Open image viewer
Mariupol is a port city on the shore of the Sea of Azov. Photo: Hilppa Hyrkäs / Yle, ©Mapcreator |OSM.org
Russia says that Russian troops have almost completely taken the port city of Mariupol. Ukrainian soldiers are now only in one factory area. Russia has demanded that the soldiers surrender.
Russia has continued air strikes in Mariupol. The city of Mariupol has been very badly destroyed.
In Mariupol there are still perhaps tens of thousands of Ukrainians who have not been able to leave the city.
## Riots in Sweden
![Riot police in riot gear stand near a burning bus.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6173,h_3472,x_0,y_297/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-942973625bb2b9b4e0c/1650258540)
Open image viewer
Rioters set a bus on fire in Malmö. Photo: Johan Nilsson / EPA
There have been riots in the city of Malmö in Sweden. Rioters threw stones and petrol bombs at police. Rioters also set fire to a bus, cars and rubbish shelters.

The riots in Malmö in Sweden began when people gathered to oppose an event by the far-right Danish politician Rasmus Paludan. Paludan has often burned Korans in public places, especially in areas where many Muslims live.
There has been rioting in Sweden for 3 days already.
## Electric cars
![An electric car charging point.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4256,h_2394,x_0,y_438/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-938401624cf90cc1393/1654534941)
Open image viewer
An electric car is charged with a charging cable. Hybrid cars can also run on petrol if the battery runs out of electricity. Photo: EPA/All Over Press
The popularity of electric cars is growing. More and more electric cars are also being bought as company cars.

Last year, 15 percent of new company cars were fully electric and 28 percent were rechargeable hybrids. Sales of fully electric cars and rechargeable hybrids as company cars quintupled from the year before.
Car companies estimate that sales of electric cars as company cars will grow further this year. One reason is that the taxation of electric cars has been reduced.
## Easter
![Easter grass in a dish.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5626,h_3165,x_0,y_316/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6620645e8b2add4f50a/1586252168)
Open image viewer
Easter grass is also among the traditional Easter customs. Photo: Eleni Paspatis / Yle

Today Easter is being celebrated. In Christianity, Easter is the festival of Jesus' resurrection. Easter is also the biggest festival of Christianity. In churches people celebrate that life has defeated death.
Many Finns eat traditional Easter foods at Easter, for example lamb and, for dessert, mämmi.
The date of Easter varies in different years between the end of March and the end of April.
## Pope Francis
![The Pope touches a statue.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_12/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-942987625bed46b5457/1650191768)
Open image viewer
Pope Francis appealed for peace in the world. Photo: Tiziana Fabi / AFP
The Pope has given the traditional Easter speech in the Vatican.
Pope Francis appealed for peace in Ukraine. The Pope also criticised Russia's attack on Ukraine. The Pope said that Ukraine has been subjected to cruel destruction and violence.
Pope Francis also reminded people of other wars in the world and called for peace in Iraq, Yemen, Libya, Lebanon and Syria.
## The weather
![Monday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12408134)
Open image viewer
On Monday it is sunny over wide areas.
On Monday it is sunny over wide areas. In eastern Finland, Kainuu and eastern Lapland cloudiness is greater, and showers may come. The temperature is between +2 and +15 degrees.
